tickets.summary: Intermittent authentication failures for some Windows clients on VPN
tickets.resolution_notes: Identified clock drift issue. Workaround: synchronize device clock. Permanent fix: deploying VPN patch v5.2.2.

tickets.summary: Access points on floor 4 are unavailable
tickets.resolution_notes: Core switch on floor 4 rebooting. Affected users moved temporarily to floor 3 or wired network.

tickets.summary: Planned connector upgrade for staging email environment
tickets.resolution_notes: Maintenance window active until 11:00 AM. Production email unaffected.

tickets.summary: Disk SMART warning on EliteDesk desktop DT-031
tickets.resolution_notes: Replacement SSD ordered under warranty. Backups confirmed complete.

tickets.summary: BitLocker PIN lock after BIOS firmware update on LT-318
tickets.resolution_notes: Provided recovery key from internal vault. TPM measurements resealed successfully.
